url.label: Video or playlist link
url.placeholder: Paste a video or playlist link

probe.idle: Paste a link in the field above to get started.

multi.hint: Each link joins the queue with the default options from Settings.

ambiguous.message: This link is a video inside a playlist.

subtitles.label: Subtitles
subtitles.onlyAuto: This video only has automatic subtitles.

embed.label: Embed cover and chapters
embed.noThumbnail: The cover cannot be embedded in {{format}}.

section.label: Download only a section
section.hint: Leave the start empty to begin at zero and the end empty to go to the end.

errors.order: The end must be after the start.
errors.beyond: The start is past the end of the video.

range.label: Range
range.hint: Numbers separated by commas. “10-” runs to the last item.

details.title: Technical details
details.description: The command that ran (cookies and proxy hidden) and yt-dlp's error output.
details.noStderr: yt-dlp wrote nothing to the error output.

template.label: File name template
template.hint: Fields inside %( ) become the video's data. E.g. %(title)s is the title.
template.title: Title only

rateLimit.label: Speed limit
rateLimit.error: Use a number ending in K, M or G, like 500K or 2M.

proxy.label: Proxy
proxy.hint: Leave empty to use no proxy.
proxy.error: Use an address starting with http://, https:// or socks5://.

retries.label: Retries
retries.hint: How many times to try again if the connection fails.
retries.error: Use a whole number from 0 to 100.

access.hint: For videos that ask you to sign in or confirm your age. Firefox is recommended.
access.chromeWarning: On Windows, Chrome blocks access to its cookies. Prefer Firefox.

unsupported.title: Unsupported link
unsupported.message: This address does not look like a site yt-dlp can read. Check the link and try again.

private.title: Video unavailable or private
private.message: The video was removed, is private or needs a login. If you have access to it, use your browser cookies in Settings.

age.title: Age-restricted video
age.message: The site asks you to sign in to confirm your age. Use your browser cookies in Settings.

bot.title: Bot check
bot.message: YouTube wants to confirm you are not a bot. Use your browser cookies in Settings.

forbidden.title: Download refused
forbidden.message: The site refused to send the video (HTTP 403). Updating yt-dlp usually fixes it.

geo.title: Not available in your region
geo.message: This video is not available in your country. A proxy in Settings may help.

extractor.title: Could not read the site
extractor.message: The site changed or yt-dlp is out of date. Update the engine in Settings and try again.

rate_limit.title: Too many requests
rate_limit.message: The site asked you to wait. Try again in a few minutes.

ffmpeg.title: ffmpeg missing or broken
ffmpeg.message: The app needs ffmpeg to merge and convert files. Reinstall it from the Engine panel.

cookies_chrome.title: Could not read Chrome cookies
cookies_chrome.message: On Windows, Chrome blocks access to its cookies. Use Firefox or turn cookies off in Settings.

disk.title: Problem with the destination folder
disk.message: There is no space or permission to write to the chosen folder. Pick another folder in Settings.

network.title: Connection problem
network.message: Could not reach the site. Check your internet connection and try again.

unknown.title: Something went wrong
unknown.message: The download failed. The technical detail below may help.

onboarding.title: Preparing the engine
onboarding.intro: First run only: the app downloads the tools it uses to download and convert videos.
onboarding.failed: Could not install {{name}}. Check your internet connection and try again.
onboarding.notFound: The install finished, but the tool was not found.
onboarding.readFailed: Could not check the installed engine. Try again.

update.label: App update
update.activeWarning: There are downloads in progress. Updating closes the app and stops them.
update.installed: Update installed. Restart the app to use the new version.
update.failed: Could not update the app. Try again later.
